title: Keto Halal Date Energy Balls
description: A no-bake keto snack made with halal beef, medjool dates, and coconut oil.

ingredients.name: Halal Ground Beef
ingredients.notes: Make sure it's 90% lean or higher

ingredients.name: Medjool Dates
ingredients.notes: Soften them in water for 10 minutes

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the halal ground beef, medjool dates, coconut oil, almond flour, and vanilla extract.
Mix everything together until you get a sticky dough.
Use your hands to shape the dough into small balls, about 1 inch in diameter.
Place the energy balls on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Refrigerate them for at least 30 minutes to set.
Store them in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 5 days.
